# AutoLeadss

> AutoLeadss (https://autoleadss.com) is a Cairo-based studio that builds AI WhatsApp agents, lead-capture pages and follow-up automations for clinics, real estate teams and beauty businesses in Egypt and the Gulf (UAE, Saudi Arabia). Every inquiry from WhatsApp, Instagram or ads gets an instant reply in Arabic or English, qualifying questions, and a booking or a handoff to the business's team. Part of MBAI Group (https://mbai-group.com).

## The problem we solve

Customers in Egypt and the Gulf ask businesses questions on WhatsApp and Instagram. When replies are slow or nobody follows up, the lead books elsewhere and the ad money behind it is lost. AutoLeadss replies in seconds, 24/7, qualifies the lead and books it.

## Who it is for

- Clinics: dental, dermatology, laser and cosmetic clinics in Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the UAE. The agent answers price, location, doctor and slot questions, books appointments, sends reminders and passes medical questions to staff. It does not give medical advice.
- Real estate: brokerages and developers in Cairo, Dubai and Riyadh. The agent replies to ad and portal leads, asks budget, area, unit type, timeline and cash or installments, books a call or viewing and hands a summary to the right agent.
- Beauty and salons: salons, lash and brow studios and spas. Bookings from Instagram and WhatsApp in one place, follow-up for people who did not book, and prepaid monthly plans through the membership storefront.

## Packages (fixed price, one-time)

- Launch, lead page for ads: EGP 18,000 in Egypt or $750 in the Gulf. Bilingual landing page or site up to 5 pages, lead form to WhatsApp and Google Sheets, click-to-chat, Meta Pixel and Google Analytics, basic SEO. 10 working days.
- Growth, AI WhatsApp agent: EGP 32,000 or $1,500. Official WhatsApp Business Platform number, AI agent trained on the business's prices and FAQs in Arabic and English, lead qualification and booking, human handoff, simple CRM and automatic follow-ups, 30 days of tuning. About 3 weeks.
- Scale, full lead system: EGP 65,000 or $3,000. Launch plus Growth, up to 5 custom automations, Meta ads account and campaign structure, dashboard, team training, 60 days of tuning. 5 to 6 weeks.
- Membership storefront: EGP 20,000 for the first five clients, then from EGP 35,000. Sells up to 3 prepaid plans, customer QR pass, staff redemption, owner dashboard.
- Optional monthly plans: Care EGP 2,500, Grow EGP 6,000, Lead Engine EGP 12,000 (ad spend extra). Monthly plans are not required.
- Payment terms: 50% to start, 50% at handoff. Meta message fees, ad spend, hosting and payment-provider fees are paid to those providers directly.

## What counts as a qualified lead

A real person who asked about a service the business sells, in an area it serves, reachable on WhatsApp, who either booked a time or answered the agreed qualifying questions (for example budget and timeline). The rules are agreed with each client before launch.

## AutoLeadss On Call (monthly retainer)

A monthly on-call digital team for small online retailers (1 to 10 staff, no in-house developer or designer) on Shopify, Salla, Zid, WooCommerce or similar. First markets: the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, the wider Gulf, the United States and the United Kingdom. Beauty is one example, not the only sector.

Clients send requests on WhatsApp. Each request goes onto a task board. Every change is checked on a preview before it goes live.

Monthly plans (month to month, paid upfront; unused hours do not roll over):

- Care, 6 hours: $450, £349, AED 1,649, SAR 1,689 or EGP 7,500. Store and site edits, fixes, up to 15 product uploads, basic SEO, uptime check.
- Growth, 15 hours (recommended): $990, £749, AED 3,649, SAR 3,709 or EGP 16,000. Everything in Care, plus up to 20 AI product images, 8 ad or social designs, 1 lead list of up to 300 verified contacts, 1 landing page or section, monthly report.
- Team, 30 hours: $1,850, £1,399, AED 6,790, SAR 6,939 or EGP 30,000. Everything in Growth, plus up to 40 AI images, 16 designs, lead lists of up to 1,000 contacts, 1 small automation a month, monthly call.

Not included: full store builds or migrations (quoted as projects), ad spend unless added, video/3D/print, third-party fees, emergency 24/7 support. The WhatsApp AI agent is an add-on at the existing Growth package price. Lead lists are delivered, not blasted.

Page: https://autoleadss.com/en/on-call (Arabic: https://autoleadss.com/ar/on-call)

## Proof

- 200+ leads generated across 3 MENA markets.
- Client project: Lash Cartel Cosmetics, an Australian beauty brand. Live store: https://lashcartelcosmetics.com
- Other work: TUT (https://tutapp.co), MBAI Group (https://mbai-group.com).

## Ownership

The business owns its domain, WhatsApp number, ad accounts, customer data and the delivered build. Payments for memberships settle in the business's own merchant account (for example Paymob), never through AutoLeadss.

## عربي

أوتوليدز استوديو في القاهرة بيبني وكلاء واتساب بالذكاء الاصطناعي وصفحات تجميع عملاء وأتمتة متابعة للعيادات وشركات العقارات ومراكز التجميل في مصر والخليج. كل استفسار بياخد رد فوري بالعربي أو الإنجليزي، وأسئلة تأهيل، وحجز أو تحويل للفريق.

الباقات: Launch صفحة عملاء ١٨٬٠٠٠ جنيه أو ٧٥٠ دولار. Growth وكيل واتساب بالذكاء الاصطناعي ٣٢٬٠٠٠ جنيه أو ١٬٥٠٠ دولار. Scale النظام الكامل ٦٥٬٠٠٠ جنيه أو ٣٬٠٠٠ دولار. متجر العضويات ٢٠٬٠٠٠ جنيه لأول خمس عملاء وبعدها من ٣٥٬٠٠٠ جنيه. الخطط الشهرية اختيارية من ٢٬٥٠٠ لـ ١٢٬٠٠٠ جنيه.

أوتوليدز أون كول خطة شهرية للمتاجر الإلكترونية الصغيرة (من ١ إلى ١٠ أفراد ومن غير مطور أو مصمم داخلي) في الإمارات والسعودية ومصر والخليج وأمريكا وبريطانيا، على Shopify أو سلة أو زد أو WooCommerce. الطلبات على واتساب، وكل تغيير بيتراجع على نسخة معاينة قبل النشر.

الباقات الشهرية: Care ٦ ساعات بـ ٤٥٠ دولار أو ٧٬٥٠٠ جنيه. Growth ١٥ ساعة بـ ٩٩٠ دولار أو ١٦٬٠٠٠ جنيه. Team ٣٠ ساعة بـ ١٬٨٥٠ دولار أو ٣٠٬٠٠٠ جنيه. الصفحة: https://autoleadss.com/ar/on-call
